nodes.description: Constant maximum supply of 500 Nebula NFTs.
Base token URI string used for metadata.
Public pause flag toggled by the owner.
Constant mint price of 0.05 ETH per token.
Pseudo-random starting index for the token reveal sequence.
Block number used as seed for the starting index.
Ownable owner address.
ERC721 mapping of owner address to token balance.
ERC721 mapping of token id to owner address.
Public payable mint function that mints _count tokens and refunds overpayment.
Owner-only function deriving startingIndex from a past block hash.
Owner-only function storing the current block number as the index seed.
Owner-only setter for the base token URI.
View function returning the token ids owned by an address.
Owner-only function that reserves a number of tokens.
Owner-only function toggling the paused state.
Owner-only function transferring the contract balance to the owner.
Internal override returning the stored base URI.
Constructor initializing ERC721 name/symbol and base URI.
Ownable modifier enforcing that msg.sender is the owner.
Internal safe mint that also calls the ERC721 receiver hook.
Internal ERC721 mint updating balances and owners.
Internal ERC721 transfer of token ownership.
Ownable view returning the current owner.
Owner-only transfer of contract ownership.
Owner-only renounce of contract ownership.
Internal callback invocation of onERC721Received on the recipient contract.
Caller-controlled address used as mint recipient and refund/withdraw target.
Low-level call sending excess ETH back to msg.sender inside mint.
Solidity transfer of the whole contract balance to msg.sender in withdrawAll.
blockhash/block.number based pseudo-randomness used to derive startingIndex.
_count parameter of mint controlling how many tokens are minted.
price = NFT_PRICE.mul(_count) local used to check payment.
remaining = msg.value.sub(price) refunded to the caller.
Loop index i iterating over the mint count.
num parameter of reserveTokens specifying how many tokens to reserve.
supply = totalSupply() snapshot used as token id base.
_owner parameter of walletOfOwner.
tokenCount = balanceOf(_owner) local used to size the array.
baseURI parameter stored into _baseTokenURI.
val parameter assigned to the paused flag.
balance = address(this).balance local read in withdrawAll.
newOwner parameter receiving contract ownership.

edges.reason: msg.sender is the caller that triggers mint and determines authorization.
_count parameter is the user-supplied mint quantity fed into mint.
NFT_PRICE constant is read to compute the mint price.
price is computed as NFT_PRICE.mul(_count), arithmetic on user input.
remaining is computed by subtracting price from msg.value.
The computed remainder is sent out through the low-level ETH call.
The refund call targets msg.sender, an attacker-controlled address able to re-enter mint.
The loop index drives repeated _safeMint invocations inside mint.
mint calls _safeMint for each token created.
_safeMint delegates the actual minting to _mint.
_safeMint calls the recipient onERC721Received hook allowing external reentry.
num parameter is the user-supplied reservation quantity.
supply is assigned from totalSupply() inside reserveTokens.
reserveTokens calls _safeMint for reserved tokens.
reserveTokens mints the reserved tokens to msg.sender.
reserveTokens initializes startingIndexBlock when unset.
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock stores block.number into startingIndexBlock.
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
baseURI parameter is supplied by the owner to setBaseURI.
setBaseURI writes the baseURI parameter into _baseTokenURI.
setBaseURI is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
_baseURI returns the stored _baseTokenURI state variable.
calcStartingIndex writes the derived value into startingIndex.
calcStartingIndex relies on blockhash for pseudo randomness.
The blockhash based random result is assigned to startingIndex.
calcStartingIndex is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
calcStartingIndex reads startingIndexBlock as the randomness seed.
pause writes the paused state flag.
val parameter is assigned to the paused flag.
pause is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
_owner parameter is the address queried by walletOfOwner.
tokenCount is assigned from balanceOf(_owner) inside walletOfOwner.
balance is assigned from address(this).balance in withdrawAll.
The computed balance is the amount sent by the transfer.
The transfer recipient is msg.sender, an externally controlled address.
withdrawAll performs an external transfer of the entire balance.
withdrawAll is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
onlyOwner calls owner() to obtain the privileged address.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against the stored owner.
owner() reads the _owner state variable.
transferOwnership writes the new owner into _owner.
newOwner parameter is the unvalidated zero-address-checked new owner.
transferOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
renounceOwnership sets _owner to the zero address.
renounceOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
constructor invokes setBaseURI during deployment.

normalization_plan.reason: The _count parameter exists only as input to the mint function and should be folded into it.
price is a temporary local computed and consumed entirely within mint.
remaining is the value passed directly into the refund low-level call operation.
The loop index i is a transient counter controlling mint's _safeMint loop.
num is the input parameter of reserveTokens and has no independent meaning.
supply is a temporary snapshot local used only inside reserveTokens.
_owner is the queried address parameter of the walletOfOwner view.
tokenCount is a transient local only used to size the returned array.
baseURI is the sole input parameter of the setBaseURI setter.
val is the boolean parameter directly stored by pause.
balance is the value passed directly into the transfer operation.
newOwner is the parameter written to _owner by transferOwnership.
